string.name: desc
string.value: Summons an arrow illusion for a short time to draw enemies in and damage them. If you get hit during the skill, you will launch a powerful counterattack.

string.name: h
string.value: MP Cost: #mpCon, summon Arrow Illusion with #x HP for #time sec\nDeal #damage% to surrounding enemies. After pulling in, Stun at #prop% chance for #subTime sec. When damage is taken, reflect #y%
